meta.name: learn-system
meta.description: Explore and explain how a system, module, or codebase works. Use when the user is onboarding, trying to understand unfamiliar code, or building a mental model.

copy.tagline: 探索并解释系统工作原理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在了解陌生代码库或系统架构
copy.tagline_en: Explore and explain how a system works.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're trying to understand unfamiliar code or system architecture.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会引导你探索系统、模块或代码库的工作原理。它会先分析入口点、高层流程、关键数据结构，然后画图展示组件与数据流，最后走一个具体场景并纠正你的理解错误。
howto.when: 当你要求解释某个系统、模块或代码库如何工作，或者你刚加入项目、尝试理解不熟悉的代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我解释这个项目的启动入口在哪里？
say.note: Claude 会分析触发条件和初始流程。

say.text: 画出这个模块的数据流图，标注外部依赖。
say.note: Claude 会生成 mermaid 或 ASCII 图。

say.text: 我理解这个系统是事件驱动架构，对吗？纠正我。
say.note: Claude 会进行苏格拉底式验证，指出错误。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to explore how a system, module, or codebase works. It starts by analyzing entry points, high-level flow, key data structures, then draws a diagram showing components and data flow, traces a concrete scenario, and corrects your misconceptions.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to understand how a system, module, or codebase works, when onboarding, or when trying to understand unfamiliar code.

say_en.text: Explain how this project starts, what is the entry point?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze triggers and initial flow.

say_en.text: Draw a data flow diagram of this module, show external dependencies.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a mermaid or ASCII diagram.

say_en.text: I think this system is event-driven, is that right? Correct me.
say_en.note: Claude will Socratic-verify and point out errors.
